column1: # known.tsv: the review tools detect.sh knows, one row each, tab between
# columns. A new tool is one new row.
#   tool   its short name, as detect.sh prints it
#   login  its GitHub app login, without `[bot]`: the author of its reviews
#          and comments, and the app of its check runs
#   status the commit status or check run it posts on each head, or `-`
# Each row was read off a public PR the tool reviewed, on 2026-10-06.
